Overall, Dinkins has the athletic traits and flashes to earn the “promising” label as both a pass catcher and blocker — his best football should be ahead of him. He can find NFL success if he lands with a team willing to cultivate his talent.

summaries: Overall, Johnson looks the part with the coverage IQ and ball skills that has NFL teams interested, but his lack of high-end speed and explosive movements could limit his impact at the next level. He is best-suited for a zone-heavy scheme.

Overall, Johnson might not have a sky-high ceiling at the next level, but his character, experience and functional size/speed traits raise his floor and will keep him earning an NFL paycheck. His game and journey are reminiscent of Rams’ 2019 seventh-rounder Nick Scott.
Overall, Hayes’ route processing and physicality need work, but he has the athletic traits to play sticky coverage. His elite pro day showing might get him drafted.
Overall, Boykin lacks desired speed and twitch for the position, but he is long, physical and mentally tough — essential ingredients for an NFL press-man corner.
Overall, Smith can be tied up against savvy route runners, but he is a good-sized athlete with length, ball skills and cover awareness, projecting best in a Cover-3 scheme.
Overall, Bernard-Converse needs to play more composed, but he has versatile experience, and his blend of length, speed and fluidity is worth molding.
Overall, some NFL teams follow a simple formula at corner: They want tall, long athletes who can run. Green falls in that category.
Overall, Hailassie needs to play with more disciplined eyes, but he is long, fluid and controlled in his movements to cover from press or off coverage.
Overall, Hawkins will get clingy and needs to improve his play recognition, but he passes the eye test with flying colors and has the athletic profile NFL teams will want to develop.
Overall, Ivey struggles to anticipate, but he is tall, long and athletic, can play both man and zone and can compete for a spot on the back end of an NFL roster.
Overall, Isaac has only average long speed and instincts and needs continued strength development, but he has pro potential with his intriguing frame and short-area explosiveness.
Overall, Speed doesn’t have the body of work or college tape of an NFL Draft pick, but he has enticing athletic gifts for his size plus a ton of special teams experience.

Overall, Johnson has straight-line tendencies as an athlete, but he is instinctive, long and physical enough to make plays in the run and pass games and on special teams.
